articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: In September 2026, 20 Australian university students departed Brisbane for Fiji aboard the CSIRO research vessel (RV) Investigator on a CAPSTAN sea training voyage. articles.title: Planetary crises deepen global health inequality, paper warns
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: The global inequality in health opportunities is being further heightened by the triple planetary crisis—climate change, biodiversity loss and environmental pollution. Addressing it is more than a question for health systems; it must be embedded as a central concern in climate and environmental policy. This is being urged by scientists from Heidelberg University whose research focuses, among other things, on global health, environment-related diseases and climate action. They advocate not only countering this inequality at the individual level but also removing its structural causes. In a paper published in the journal Nature Human Behaviour, they explain the approaches required in research and policymaking.

articles.title: This new concrete is stronger and pulls CO2 from the air
articles.summary: Researchers have created a concrete mixture that is both stronger and capable of absorbing carbon dioxide. It also captured about 1.2 grams of CO₂ per day in laboratory testing.

articles.title: The end of humanity? What would happen if the Yellowstone supervolcano erupted now
articles.summary: A Yellowstone super-eruption would begin not with a sudden surprise, but with weeks of increasingly alarming warning signs such as migrating earthquake swarms, rapid ground uplift, changing geysers, and rising volcanic gases. In a worst-case scenario, those signals could culminate in a VEI 8 eruption that blasts ash tens of kilometers into the atmosphere, unleashes deadly pyroclastic flows, buries parts of the western United States in ash, and cripples transportation, electricity, water systems, agriculture, and communications across much of North America.
